### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8067c249758c56ad01bb350a62fb3f0f93a103af` — the merge of head `035ecdcf0a8a46b4f47bdb7cd4b3ca12a0abb735` into base `4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8067c249758c56ad01bb350a62fb3f0f93a103af && git checkout 8067c249758c56ad01bb350a62fb3f0f93a103af
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10 035ecdcf0a8a46b4f47bdb7cd4b3ca12a0abb735 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10 && git merge --no-ff 035ecdcf0a8a46b4f47bdb7cd4b3ca12a0abb735

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4d1f52c4458372169bf641f58db312734da5fb10` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `035ecdcf0a8a46b4f47bdb7cd4b3ca12a0abb735`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/export-format-refusal.test.ts, packages/rest/src/clone-overrides-refusal.test.ts + packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.export-job-family-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts, packages/types/src/response-envelope.ts, packages/rest/src/query-allowlist.ts, packages/rest/src/query-multiplicity.ts, packages/rest/src/import-template.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/request-body.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts, ui/packages/types/src/data.ts, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExport.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/LiveReportExporter.ts, content/docs/api/data-api.mdx, packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md, docs/adr/0112-error-code-vocabulary-and-ledger.md

Face: narrowing — the paths decide no face and the changeset's line-initial `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` decides it (`record-recognisers.mjs` says the same of this file list), so the floor is every path of the diff outside the prose faces; the `.changeset` is judged in ②.

Inputs: cards #27500 and #27489 (bodies, triage, claims, the os-dev-report posted 2026-10-29T16:41Z on #27500, the pointer on #27489), PR #27659 body and file list, `git diff origin/main...pr27659` at this head (4 files, +288/−8, read whole), the cited code in the live tree, and the head's check-runs read at this record's writing. Not the dispatch order and not the dispatching seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, judged against the live tree:

1. **Export: a present `format` outside `csv`, `json`, `xlsx` (any case, trimmed; the empty and blank value included) answers 400 instead of a csv file — RIGHT.** Before (base blob `11546c50`, lines 1074–1076) `String(q.format ?? 'csv').toLowerCase()` folded every non-`json`/`xlsx` value to csv. After, `readExportFormat` answers `undefined` for an unserved value and the handler refuses before `findData` and before any header. `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` lists `format`, so an array never reaches the reader; `readTemplateMode` (`import-template.ts` 333–338) already reads the same parameter trimmed and lower-cased and refuses a non-`xlsx` value under `template=true` with the same code, so the two readings of one parameter now agree in posture.
2. **Export: an absent `format` is still csv — RIGHT (preserved).** `raw === undefined` answers `'csv'`; pinned.
3. **Export: `format=` (empty) is refused rather than read as absent — RIGHT.** The posture this route already gives `limit=` (`readDeclaredQueryNumber`, `emptyIsAbsent: false`, `rest-server.ts` 870) and `template=true` gives `format`. The card allowed either ("An absent `format` may still default to CSV"); the dev took the stricter, already-practised reading and declared it in the changeset.
4. **Export: the spec enum members `jsonl` and `parquet` are refused — RIGHT, and this PR owes no spec lane.** `packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts` lines 64–66 state the served door reads "its own `format` read, not `ExportFormat` above", and the ADR-0087 D3 entry `export-job-family-retired` says the door "answers the file itself as CSV, JSON or XLSX. ExportFormat stays published (ExportImportTemplate still references it)". The refusal makes the spec's own statement real on the wire. Senders measured in the tree: the SDK's `data.export` types `format?: 'csv' | 'json' | 'xlsx'` (`client/src/index.ts` 7442); the Console's `exportDownload` folds `ExportDownloadRequest.format` (`'csv' | 'json' | 'xlsx'`, `ui/packages/types/src/data.ts` 1303) to one of the three before it sets the query; `ReportExport.tsx` builds csv/xlsx in the browser and never calls the door; the `'pdf'` default in `LiveReportExporter.ts` never reaches `/data/:object/export` (no fetch of it in that file); dogfood sends `format=json` only (`import-user-field-target`, `second-object-exposure`); no skill and no page under `content/docs/` names an export `format` value for this route (the only `jsonl`/`parquet` mention is the generated `references/api/export.mdx` row for `ExportImportTemplate.format`, a template field). Zero senders of an unserved value.
5. **Clone: a nested `overrides` that is a string, number, boolean, `null` or array answers 400 instead of 201 — RIGHT.** Before, `overrides && typeof overrides === 'object'` dropped primitives and `null` silently and forwarded arrays, which `cloneData` (`protocol.ts` 13788) `Object.assign`s index-wise. After, `isFieldMap` guards at the door, before `cloneData`. The protocol's own signature is `overrides?: Record` of string keys to any values — optional, not nullable — so the door now guarantees exactly the type it calls with. No caller in the tree sends a non-object: the SDK sends `overrides ? { overrides } : {}`, the Console has no record-clone caller, and every in-repo test sends `{}` or an object.
6. **Clone: a bare body that is an array, string or number answers 400 — RIGHT** (the same guard, `nested=false` arm). The adapter already refuses a framed `text/plain` or octet body on read (`readRequestBody`), so the "got a string" arm is reached only by a JSON string literal.
7. **Clone: `"overrides": null` is refused while a bare `null` body, an empty body and no body stay a plain copy — DEFENSIBLE, decided and declared.** The asymmetry is the pre-existing `req.body ?? {}` fold every data door shares, plus the adapter's own fold of an empty `application/json` body to `{}` (`request-body.ts`: whitespace-only text answers `{ body: {} }`), so a header-only POST stays a plain copy — checked, no regression. Inside a JSON object, `null` is a value the author typed against a member declared optional-not-nullable, and letting it through would reach `Object.assign(data, null)` as a silent no-op, the silent-coercion shape both cards name. The route's `readDeclaredQueryNumber` does fold `null` to absent, but that arm serves the query string, where `null` cannot be sent. Residual, not a finding: an external typed client that serialises an unset optional as `null` now gets a 400 whose message names the fix; the changeset says so under "Who sees it".
8. **Public surface: nothing moves.** `isFieldMap`, `describeNonFieldMap`, `EXPORT_FORMATS`, `readExportFormat` are module-private; `packages/spec`, `packages/client` and `packages/types` are untouched; `check:api-surface` has nothing to see. RIGHT.
9. **Error code and envelope — RIGHT.** Both refusals go through `sendError` (`@objectstack/types`, the nested `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }` writer the `check:route-envelope` ratchet converges on) with `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the standard catalog's 400 member and `HttpStatusErrorCodeMap[400]`. On this route that is the code the same parameter already answers (`readTemplateMode`'s `format` refusal) and the code both query gates answer (`refuseUnknownQueryParams`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`). Recorded for the reader: the route's `limit=` refusal answers the producer-named `VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[]` (a declared-schema parse through `validationFailure`), and the `object is required` and `filter must be JSON` arms still write the flat `{ code, error }` dialect — a pre-existing two-dialect state owned by the envelope ratchet, not widened here. `INVALID_FORMAT` (field-level semantics) and the ledgered `INVALID_REQUEST` (the flat dialect's code) would have been the wrong choices.
10. **Messages name the parameter, the value (export) or the kind (clone), and the served set; no tracker number in any runtime string.** RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/27500-27489-rest-door-refuse-malformed.md`: `'@objectstack/rest': patch`; title `fix(rest)!: …`; line-initial `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the BREAKING banner with before / now / unchanged / who sees it / remedy; the adr-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` with its why. The PR body carries the same two lines plus the `Skills-docs: none — …` line a `(narrowing)` arm owes, and its reason holds (no skill teaches either door's malformed values; `data-api.mdx` describes the clone body as `{ "overrides": { … } }` only and says nothing about the export `format` set).
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right classification.** The question the claim line answers is whether the card widens an accept set or enlarges the public surface — it does not, so the claims' `no` stands; the arm names what the diff does to a published door's observable accept set: values that answered 200/201 now answer 400 at two public REST doors. That is how this package has declared the identical shape before — the `limit=` refusal (CHANGELOG entry `95ab93f`: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` with the BREAKING banner) and the import doors' refusal of two request shapes (`Clause-②: no (narrowing) — … Nothing is widened.`). The claims' bare `no` is not contradicted; the arm is the dev's duty from the diff, and the report says the dispatch asked for the decision. Confirmed.
- **`patch` is right.** `Metadata-protocol: none`, so the level follows the kind and a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its banner and disposition (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3); `major` is refused by `check-changeset-no-major` in any case.
- **The BREAKING text matches the diff**, read line by line against the base blob and the head: `format=` (empty) did answer csv; arrays did reach the clone and merge index-wise; the SDK does send only accepted shapes; nothing authorable is removed or renamed, so no FROM → TO rewrite and no tombstone is owed, and the remedy paragraph is the one-line fix.
- **ADR-0087 marker** `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no schema key, export or stored shape changes; the body carries a remedy, not a rewrite prescription; the mechanical re-validation of this category (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base`, run by the `Check Changeset` job) is `success` on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (os-dev-report on #27500, `deviations`), each answered:

1. *Clause-② arm `no (narrowing)` where the claims say `no` — seat to confirm.* Confirmed; see ②.
2. *Commit shape: a separate `test(rest): type the clone refusal test's parsed body` commit because folding by `--force-with-lease` was refused.* No contract effect; accepted as declared.
3. *Lock narrowing: the first run of the two new suites and the two-file dogfood re-run ran without the verify lock.* A process declaration; the final head's closure build, package test, typecheck and full dogfood battery ran under the lock. No contract effect; noted.
4. *Four writes against the three-write budget (the pointer on #27489 was dispatch-ordered).* A seat-budget matter, not a contract one; noted.

`open_questions`: none declared.

`out_of_scope_findings` — *a clone body carrying `overrides` plus other top-level keys reads only `overrides` and drops the rest, unchanged.* Escalated to the seat, not a finding on this PR: it is the same silent-drop family as both cards and is measurable in minutes with the harness the new test boots; keeping it out of a two-card fold was right. Recommend a card, dedupe words as the report gives them.

Two further boundary notes for the seat, neither a finding on this diff:
- The served set now has a refusal but still no spec-declared request schema for this door (the `limit=` comment's "No request schema is declared for this door" still holds), so the vocabulary lives in a route-local constant. Correct for this card — a `packages/spec` edit would be a schema face and a different lane — and the long-term home is a declared door schema.
- `ExportFormat` keeps publishing `jsonl` and `parquet` that no route serves, and `ExportImportTemplate`, its last consumer, has zero importers outside `packages/spec`. Spec-lane ADR-0049 debt, pre-existing and disclaimed by the spec's own comment; not this PR's.

PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay login to name.

Check-runs on this head at this record's writing (2026-10-29T16:56Z): `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Type Check · workspace` and every other Lint / Type Check sub-job, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Test UI` — `success`; `Test Core` shards 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 and 8 — `success`, shards 3 and 4 — `in_progress`; the UI and opt-in jobs — `skipped` by the path filter (no `ui/` path in the diff). Nothing red. The landing precondition "every check green" is the seat's to re-read once the two shards conclude; this record does not wait for them.

### ④ Design judgment

Per in-scope file, against the code it cites and the scenario it is accepted against. Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.

**`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`**
- `readExportFormat` holds: `undefined` answers csv; otherwise `String(raw).trim().toLowerCase()` is tested against `EXPORT_FORMATS`. `?format=` and `?format=%20` land on `''` and `' '` and are refused (pinned); a bare `?format` reads as `''` under URLSearchParams semantics and lands on the same refusal (not separately pinned). Arrays are stopped one line earlier by `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, which lists `format`, so `String(raw)` never sees one. The chosen value flows typed (`ExportFormatServed`) into the existing `format === 'csv' | 'xlsx' | 'json'` writer arms and into `exportContentDisposition(…, ext: string)`.
- Placement holds: after `enforceAuth`, `enforceApiAccess('export')` and `enforceExportPermission` (an unauthorised caller still gets its 401/403, not a format lecture), after the `template=true` branch (whose own `format` read is unchanged), before the `limit` read and before `findData`, so no row is read and no `X-Export-Format` or `Content-Disposition` is set on a refusal — the test asserts the header is absent.
- The clone guard holds: `nested = isFieldMap(body) && 'overrides' in body`; `overrides = nested ? body.overrides : body`; refused iff present and not a field map. The pre-existing shapes reach `cloneData` byte-for-byte as before: `{ overrides: { … } }` gives that map; `{ name: 'x' }` gives the bare map; `{}`, a `null` body and no body give `overrides: {}` (the old `typeof {} === 'object'` arm forwarded `{}` too). Tried to break it with a header-only `application/json` POST: the adapter folds an empty body to `{}` before the handler, so it stays a plain copy. Tried `text/plain` with a body: the adapter refuses on read before the guard, unchanged.
- The code comment "as `limit=` above is refused rather than read as absent" is accurate for the posture (`emptyIsAbsent: false`); the code `limit=` answers differs (①.9) and the comment does not claim otherwise.
- No new hand-built `res.json` body: both refusals go through the shared writer, so the `check:route-envelope` count for this module does not move.

**`packages/rest/src/export-format-refusal.test.ts`**
- Boots the real `HonoHttpServer` and `RestServer` with a mocked protocol, so the production query parser and allowlist run. The refusal half pins status, `error.code`, that the message names `"format"` and `csv, json, xlsx`, no `X-Export-Format`, and `findData` never called — for `pdf`, `xml`, empty, blank and `jsonl` (the spec-enum member). The preservation half pins absent → csv with the row streamed, and each served spelling → its own `X-Export-Format` with `findData` called. Both halves the route rule asks for are present; the format is not a `findData` argument, so the header is the right preservation witness.

**`packages/rest/src/clone-overrides-refusal.test.ts`**
- The same real-adapter boot, so the JSON body is parsed by `readRequestBody`. Nine refusal shapes each pin 400, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `"overrides"` in the message and `cloneData` never called; five preserved shapes pin 201 and the exact `overrides` that `cloneData` received (`toMatchObject` on the call's first argument — the arguments pin), plus the no-body case. The `null`-body row documents the asymmetry ①.7 names instead of leaving it implicit.

**The narrowing against the published spec on `main`:** it takes no declared capability away at any consumer — the SDK's declared `format` union and `overrides` parameter type, the Console's request type, the docs' `{ "overrides": { … } }` body and the protocol's `overrides?: Record` already describe only what the doors now accept — and it makes the spec's own disclaimer of `ExportFormat` for this route real on the wire. Both cards' expected answers (a 400 naming the value and the served set; a 400 naming `overrides`, at the REST door, before `cloneData`) are met.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `035ecdcf0a8a46b4f47bdb7cd4b3ca12a0abb735` · 2026-10-29T16:59Z

- **形态:** 4 files, +288/−8: `data-action-routes.ts`, two new test files, one changeset. No `packages/spec`, no `metadata-protocol` edit, no governed path; Tier S. Fixes #27500 and #27489 (fold, same file).
- **Clause-②:** the claims said `no`; the dev corrected it to `no (narrowing)` (both doors refuse values they used to accept). The seat confirms the correction. Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (claim `6502720705`), record `6503044025`: **PASS**, no must-fix, no should-fix. Changeset: patch + BREAKING note + remedy + ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; `Check Changeset` success.
- **前提实测:** before the fix `?format=pdf` / `?format=xml` / `?format=` answered 200 csv, and a non-object `overrides` answered 201 plain copy (the new suites red on the old coercions: ablation export 5 failed, clone 9 failed, both restored to the HEAD blob).
- **抽查读数:** the seat read the clone hunk on this head: `nested = isFieldMap(body) && 'overrides' in body`; a present non-field-map `overrides` (or bare body) is refused through `sendError` with `VALIDATION_ERROR` before `cloneData`; a bare `null` or no body keeps the shared `req.body ?? {}` fold (plain copy).
- **门禁 check-runs:** 48 on this head: 34 success, 14 skipped, 0 other (read 2026-10-29T16:59Z); `mergeable_state: clean`. Derived gates 59/59, 0 NOT-MEASURED; rest 6615 passed / 326 skipped.
- **接受的偏差:** a separate typing commit beside the two card commits (no contract effect); two small runs outside the verify lock while the lock queue timed out (all heavy runs under it); four writes against a three-write budget (the #27489 pointer the order asked for). Dogfood battery: 2 timeouts in files that never call either door, green alone at a longer timeout; the PR's Dogfood Regression Gate check-run is success.
- **范围外去向:** a clone body with `overrides` beside other top-level keys drops the others → filed #27669 (same silent-drop class). The review's (b) export door without a declared request schema and (c) `ExportFormat` publishing unserved `jsonl`/`parquet` are spec-lane debt, recorded in the review, not filed by this seat. `Skills-docs: none` (verified by the review).
- **散文面:** the changeset checked against the diff (before / now / unchanged / who sees it / remedy).
- **落地条款:** relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the merge queue. #27501(a) (same file) dispatches after this merges.
